proof_method.closure: desorb eligible original targets, then exhaust all live forward hydrolysis transitions in reaction/site order
proof_method.live_semantics: every witness event is applied through petra_core::Engine::step_with using the compiled production deck
proof_method.no_go_rule: a forward reaction can remove each initially intact adjacent bridge at most once; reverse condensation restores the same increment and adsorption-created oxygen states have zero net additional bridge-removal capacity

rare_event_method.estimator_contract: for preregistered T and N, validate finite log weights, compute ESS=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2), and estimate mean(w*N_original_lattice_release(T))/T; zero releases remain exactly zero and cannot create a rank
rare_event_method.failure_or_censor: nonfinite weights or failed preregistered ESS invalidate the scenario; zero lineage-valid releases are censored/unrankable
rare_event_method.name: finite-horizon reaction-tilted CTMC importance sampling
rare_event_method.path_reweighting_rule: log(P/Q) += (Lambda_biased-Lambda_physical)*dt - ln(factor_fired); deadline censor segments omit the fired-event term
rare_event_method.stopping_rule: fixed physical-time horizon T and fixed replica count N; each replica stops at T or a declared numerical failure
